title.ja: 箱の外は雪じゃなかった
title.es: Fuera de la caja no había nieve

logline: 생선 냄새를 따라간 아기 펭귄 모찌가 화물 상자에서 잠든 사이, 고래 유람선이 그를 네온 도시로 데려간다.

bgm.name: s1e01_harbor
bgm.prompt: Cozy lofi hip hop instrumental for a cute wordless animal cartoon: warm Rhodes piano, soft vinyl crackle, gentle boom-bap drums at 76 BPM, music box melody, a hint of ocean breeze pad, curious and tender mood that turns slightly wondrous at the end, no vocals, no sudden changes

cuts.action: 유치원 줄은 전부 왼쪽, 모찌만 지도를 거꾸로 들고 오른쪽
cuts.scene: Antarctic snowfield at pastel dawn, wide shot. A line of four fluffy grey baby penguin chicks waddles to the LEFT following a gentle adult penguin with a rose-pink scarf at the front. At the very end of the line Mochi confidently waddles to the RIGHT, the opposite way, holding a paper map upside down. Funny contrast.

sfx.name: waddle
sfx.prompt: cute cartoon tiny footsteps waddling on snow, playful

narr.ko: 남극 펭귄 유치원의 아침 산책. 한 명만 방향이 다릅니다.
narr.en: Morning walk at the penguin kindergarten. One of them has a different plan.
narr.ja: 南極ペンギン幼稚園の朝のお散歩。ひとりだけ方向が違います。
narr.es: Paseo matutino en la guardería de pingüinos. Uno va en otra dirección.

cuts.action: 엄마가 배낭에 빛나는 조약돌을 넣어 줌
cuts.scene: Close two-shot. The mom penguin with a rose-pink scarf gently tucks a small glowing warm-yellow pebble into Mochi's open cherry-red backpack. Mochi looks up at her happily. Cozy round ice houses behind, soft sparkles.

narr.ko: 이 아이는 모찌. 엄마가 준 조약돌은 '집'이라는 뜻입니다.
narr.en: This is Mochi. The pebble from Mom means "home."
narr.ja: この子はモチ。ママがくれた小石は「おうち」という意味です。
narr.es: Este es Mochi. La piedrita de mamá significa «hogar».

cuts.scene: Wide shot of an icy harbor. A giant friendly smiling blue whale works as a cruise ship: a wooden deck with railings on its back, tiny tourist animals (rabbits, foxes, bears in scarves) taking pictures, and its blowhole spouting a tall water column like a ship horn. In the foreground Mochi seen from behind, looking up in awe.

sfx.name: whale_horn
sfx.prompt: deep friendly whale call that sounds like a ship horn, cartoon

narr.ko: 그날, 고래 유람선이 들어왔습니다. 네, 고래입니다.
narr.en: That day, the whale ferry came in. Yes. A whale.
narr.ja: その日、クジラの遊覧船がやって来ました。はい、クジラです。
narr.es: Ese día llegó el ferri ballena. Sí, una ballena.

cuts.scene: Mochi sniffing the air with closed eyes and tiny beak pointed up, tiptoeing. A wavy pastel scent trail with little fish icons floats from a pile of wooden cargo crates on the icy dock toward Mochi's beak.

sfx.name: sniff
sfx.prompt: cute cartoon sniffing, two quick sniffs

narr.en: Mochi's nose picked up a lead.
narr.ja: モチの鼻が、何かを見つけました。
narr.es: La nariz de Mochi encontró una pista.

cuts.scene: Mochi peeking over the edge of an open wooden crate full of shiny silver fish packed in ice. Mochi's eyes have turned into sparkling stars, a little drool, both flippers gripping the crate edge.

narr.en: Fish. An entire crate of it.
narr.ja: 魚。それも、ひと箱まるごと。

cuts.scene: Mochi sits inside the crate happily gobbling fish: cheeks stuffed round, one fish tail sticking out of its beak, a fish in each flipper, fish flying in the air.
cuts.alt_scene: Mochi mid-gulp with head tilted back swallowing a whole fish, belly visibly bigger, fish bones flying out behind.

sfx.name: munch
sfx.prompt: fast cute cartoon munching and gobbling, nom nom nom

narr.en: Self-control was never part of the plan.
narr.ja: がまんは、最初から予定にありませんでした。
narr.es: El autocontrol nunca estuvo en el plan.

cuts.action: 다 먹고 배 빵빵, 상자 안에서 꾸벅
cuts.scene: Top-down view inside the wooden crate. Mochi lies on its back among neat fish bones, belly hugely round like a ball, sleepy happy half-closed eyes, a tiny burp cloud, the cherry-red backpack used as a pillow.
cuts.alt_scene: Top-down view inside the wooden crate. Mochi lies on its back among neat fish bones, belly hugely round like a ball, now fast asleep with eyes closed and a snot bubble from the beak, the cherry-red backpack used as a pillow.

sfx.name: burp
sfx.prompt: tiny cute cartoon burp then a sleepy sigh

narr.ja: 食事終了。そして、おひるね。
narr.es: Fin de la cena. Empieza la siesta.

cuts.action: 펠리컨 하역부가 뚜껑을 닫고 도시 도장 쾅
cuts.scene: A burly pelican dock worker in a small cap slams the lid shut on a wooden crate and presses a big rubber stamp on it; the stamp mark is a simple pictogram of skyscrapers (no letters). A tiny grey penguin foot barely sticks out of the lid gap. Behind, other pelicans carry crates in their huge beak pouches toward the whale ferry.

sfx.name: stamp
sfx.prompt: heavy wooden lid slam and a rubber stamp thud, cartoon

narr.ko: 펠리컨은 일을 참 꼼꼼하게 합니다. 도장: 도시행.
narr.en: Pelicans are thorough workers. Stamp: to the city.
narr.ja: ペリカンは仕事がていねいです。スタンプ：都会行き。
narr.es: Los pelícanos trabajan con esmero. Sello: a la ciudad.

cuts.action: 펠리컨이 부리 주머니에 상자를 넣고 고래 유람선으로
cuts.gag: 코 고는 상자를 흘끗 보는 펠리컨
cuts.scene: The pelican dock worker carries the stamped crate inside its huge stretched beak pouch, waddling up a ramp onto the whale cruise ship, glancing sideways at the crate because small sleeping bubbles float out of it.

sfx.name: snore
sfx.prompt: tiny cute cartoon snoring, two snores

narr.ko: 상자가 왜 코를 고는지는 아무도 묻지 않았습니다.
narr.en: Nobody asked why the crate was snoring.
narr.ja: 箱がなぜいびきをかくのか、誰も聞きませんでした。
narr.es: Nadie preguntó por qué la caja roncaba.

cuts.action: 엄마가 머릿수를 세다가 한 자리 빈 걸 발견
cuts.scene: The mom penguin with a rose-pink scarf counts a row of four baby penguin chicks with her flipper. At the end of the row is an empty spot marked by a dotted-outline silhouette of a missing chick. Mom's eyes are wide in shock. Far behind, the whale ferry sails away into a pastel sunset.

sfx.name: count
sfx.prompt: four quick cute marimba notes going up, then a comedic record-scratch stop

cuts.action: 밤바다, 상자 안에서 쿨쿨, 조약돌이 빛남
cuts.scene: Night sea under a starry sky with pastel aurora. The whale ferry swims calmly. On its deck a wooden crate is shown in cutaway view: Mochi sleeps curled up inside, and the pebble in the cherry-red backpack glows softly warm.

sfx.name: night_sea
sfx.prompt: calm ocean waves at night, gentle, soft

narr.en: And so Mochi crossed the ocean. Asleep.
narr.ja: こうしてモチは海を渡りました。寝たまま。
narr.es: Y así Mochi cruzó el océano. Dormido.

cuts.scene: Stormy sea with big waves, rain and a lightning bolt. The wooden crate tumbles and slides across the whale's wet deck. Mochi's two surprised round eyes are visible through a gap in the crate.

sfx.name: storm
sfx.prompt: thunder crack with heavy rain and a wooden box tumbling, cartoon

cuts.scene: Dark inside of the wooden crate. A thin beam of colorful neon light comes through a crack in the lid and lands on Mochi's face. Mochi is just waking up with one eye open and messy feathers, hugging the cherry-red backpack.

sfx.name: city_hum
sfx.prompt: distant muffled city ambience heard from inside a box, soft

narr.ko: 눈을 떠 보니, 빛의 색이 이상합니다.
narr.en: When Mochi woke up, the light looked… wrong.
narr.ja: 目を覚ますと、光の色がなんだか変です。
narr.es: Al despertar, la luz se veía… rara.

cuts.scene: Close-up. The crate lid is lifted just a little; only Mochi's two big glossy eyes and the top of its fluffy grey head peek out from the dark gap. Colorful neon reflections sparkle in the eyes.

sfx.name: creak
sfx.prompt: small wooden lid creaking open slowly

narr.ja: 南極の光は、ピンクに点滅しませんから。
narr.es: La luz de la Antártida no parpadea en rosa.

cuts.scene: Wide establishing shot from behind tiny Mochi standing in an open crate on a dock. A huge glowing pastel-neon harbor city at night built for animals: giraffes working as cranes lifting containers with their long necks, an elephant bus with seats on its back, pelican dock workers, owl streetlamps, glowing signs showing only pictograms. No snow anywhere. Overwhelming and magical.

sfx.name: reveal
sfx.prompt: big magical reveal whoosh with shimmering city ambience

narr.en: Outside the box, there was no snow.
narr.ja: 箱の外は、雪ではありませんでした。
narr.es: Fuera de la caja no había nieve.

cuts.scene: Front medium close-up of Mochi standing in the open crate, neon city lights glowing softly behind, shocked expression with tiny open beak and wide eyes, both flippers raised.
cuts.video_prompt: The baby penguin blinks in shock, looks left then right, then hugs its red backpack tightly and shivers a little. Neon lights flicker softly in the background. Gentle camera push-in. Keep the flat cartoon style.

sfx.name: gulp
sfx.prompt: cute cartoon gulp and a tiny nervous squeak

narr.ko: 모찌는 집에 갈 수 있을까요? (다음 화에 계속)
narr.en: Can Mochi find the way home? (To be continued)
narr.ja: モチはおうちに帰れるのでしょうか。（つづく）

upload_title: 상자 밖은 눈이 아니었다 🐧 | Not Snow Outside the Box · Tailored EP1
